title: Build acceptance URNs as acc:{wagon}:{wmbt_id}-{harness}-{NNN}[-{slug}] via URNBuilder.acceptance

facts.note: Planner authors or renames an acceptance entry in a plan/wagon artifact.
Planning artifacts that declare acceptance ids.
Task text mentions acceptances or their URNs.
Diff-level observer that extracts acc:* strings added/changed and matches them against the acceptance_urn pattern.

fires: Planner adds a new acceptance under a WMBT and must assign its URN.
Planner writes an acceptance URN by hand in a plan or wagon document.
Planner migrates a legacy acc:{wagon}:{nnn}:{acceptance_id} id to the new format.
doesNotFire: Editing acceptance body text (given/when/then) without touching its URN.
Authoring URNs for non-acceptance entities (wagons, WMBTs, contracts).
Choosing which harness code exists in the vocabulary (governed by planner.acceptance.harness-vocabulary).

given: A planning artifact declares an acceptance tied to a WMBT within a wagon and executed by a specific harness.
when: The planner assigns or changes that acceptance's URN.
then: The URN must be acc:{wagon}:{wmbt_id}-{harness}-{NNN}[-{slug}], produced via URNBuilder.acceptance(wagon_id, wmbt_id, harness_code, seq, slug=None).
prefer: Call URNBuilder.acceptance(wagon_id, wmbt_id, harness_code, seq, slug=None) rather than concatenating strings by hand.
Use colons only for hierarchy (acc:wagon:wmbt_id) and dashes for the facet cluster (-harness-NNN[-slug]).
Use a kebab-case wagon, a WMBT id of step code + 3-digit seq (e.g. C004), an UPPERCASE harness code, a per-harness sequence 001-999 (never 000), and an optional kebab-case slug for readability.

WMBT step letter must be one of D L P C E M Y R K; harness code must be one of UNIT, HTTP, EVENT, WS, E2E, A11Y, VIS, METRIC, JOB, DB, SEC, LOAD, SCRIPT, WIDGET, GOLDEN, BLOC, INTEGRATION, RLS, EDGE, REALTIME, STORAGE, SMOKE. Full pattern: ^acc:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[DLPCEMYRK][0-9]{3}-(UNIT|HTTP|EVENT|WS|E2E|A11Y|VIS|METRIC|JOB|DB|SEC|LOAD|SCRIPT|WIDGET|GOLDEN|BLOC|INTEGRATION|RLS|EDGE|REALTIME|STORAGE|SMOKE)-[0-9]{3}(?:-[a-z0-9-]+)?$
avoid: The legacy format acc:{wagon}:{nnn}:{acceptance_id} (e.g. acc:authenticate-user:001:AC-EXEC-201) — it is being migrated away.
Dropping the WMBT id or harness code from the URN, or sharing one sequence across harnesses.
Lowercase or unlisted harness codes, step letters outside D/L/P/C/E/M/Y/R/K, or non-kebab slugs.
why: The URN is the canonical id of an acceptance: it makes the WMBT tie explicit, bakes in harness visibility for routing, keeps a per-harness sequence, and allows an optional readability slug.
evidence: Every new/changed acceptance URN matches the acceptance_urn pattern (prefer[3]) and its NNN is in 001-999.
No URN in the legacy form acc:{wagon}:{nnn}:{acceptance_id} (e.g. acc:authenticate-user:001:AC-EXEC-201) is newly introduced.
verifier_detail: Term acceptance_urn (label 'Acceptance URN'): the canonical id of an acceptance.

Pattern: ^acc:[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[DLPCEMYRK][0-9]{3}-(UNIT|HTTP|EVENT|WS|E2E|A11Y|VIS|METRIC|JOB|DB|SEC|LOAD|SCRIPT|WIDGET|GOLDEN|BLOC|INTEGRATION|RLS|EDGE|REALTIME|STORAGE|SMOKE)-[0-9]{3}(?:-[a-z0-9-]+)?$ — note the regex alone accepts NNN=000; parts definition restricts NNN to 001-999 per harness.
Parts: wagon = kebab-case wagon; wmbt_id = step code + seq (C004); harness = UPPERCASE harness code; NNN = per-harness 001-999; slug = optional kebab descriptor.
Separator semantics: colon = hierarchy (acc:wagon:wmbt_id); dash = facet cluster (-harness-NNN[-slug]).
Counter-example to flag: acc:authenticate-user:001:AC-EXEC-201 (legacy acc:{wagon}:{nnn}:{acceptance_id}, being migrated).
